description: Silvery cord wound tight and bound at the waist, cool to the touch. No hand in Nangijala spun this one.
lore: They arrive. Four or five a season at [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]]'s door, always overnight, always wound the same way and bound at the waist with the same two-turn knot, and in nine years she has not once caught whoever leaves them. No hand spun the cord — look close and the strands are laid rather than twisted — but a hand wound it into a skein and a hand tied that knot, and a knot is a habit, and a habit is a person. It is the strongest thread anybody here has, and twenty-six gold is cheap for it. Jehanne does not sell hers. She puts bread out on the nights she thinks one is coming, and the bread goes, and she has stopped telling people about it — the last time she did, three of them offered to sit up and watch with her, and she said no rather too fast.
gm_notes: A standing trade with somebody who will not be met, run by a priestess who protects it from being solved. She keeps an appointment she knows is empty; this one might not be.
